title: manilkara bidentata subsp. surinamensis
intro: Manilkara bidentata subsp. surinamensis, commonly known as the Yellow Sapote or Amazon Tree Lettuce, is a plant species belonging to the Sapotaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which may aid in treating various conditions such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Manilkara bidentata subsp. surinamensis include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and modulate the immune system. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
